architecture.mechanism: Use of viscous oil to lubricate rolling bearings in high-turn engine components
architecture.intervention: Perform root cause analysis at 51,000 miles to identify the source of metal fragments, then switch to a specified viscous oil formulation for the turbocharger rolling bearings and flush the lubrication circuit to remove existing contamination.
architecture.expected_effect: The viscous oil maintains a thicker hydrodynamic film on the turbocharger rolling bearings, preventing metal-to-metal contact, halting further fragment generation, and eliminating abnormal engine compartment sounds.
architecture.falsification_test: After flushing and refilling with viscous oil, operate the 2021 Nissan Altima at various speeds for 500 miles; collect an oil sample and perform ferrographic analysis to confirm absence of new metal fragments and verify that abnormal sounds have ceased.
